== Biography ==
'''Janet Glasgow''' was baptised at Kilbirnie, Ayrshire, on 17 Jul 1748. The parish register names her father as William and her mother as Janet.<ref name="FMP1" /> Because the entry records a baptism rather than a birth, her birth is placed before that date, and Kilbirnie is inferred from the baptism rather than independently recorded.

== Research Notes ==
The baptism is the only record found for Janet Glasgow; it establishes her parents and baptism but gives no later life, marriage or death. Another Glasgow child, [[Glasgow-4139|William Glasgow]], was baptised at Kilbirnie the following year to a John Glasgow; the two families are not shown to be related.

A possible identification concerns Joannet Glasgow. The banns/marriage index records Joannet Glasgow and Andrew Allexander/ on 8 August 1661 at Glasgow.<ref>Scotland’s People: Old Parish Registers — banns and marriages: OPR 644 / 1/230 / 230; [https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/ record].</ref> The original parish register image has not been inspected. The combined index date does not by itself identify the precise event type. The identification remains uncertain.
